column3: LEAVE is valid only in a repetitive loop or labeled block instruction.
ITERATE is valid only in a repetitive loop.
Symbol following LEAVE ("&1") must either match the label of a current loop or block instruction or be omitted.
Symbol following ITERATE ("&1") must either match the label of a current loop or be omitted.
Symbol following ITERATE ("&1") names a block that is not a loop.
LEAVE in a CATCH clause must not target the block on line &1 to which the clause belongs.
ITERATE in a CATCH clause must not target the block on line &1 to which the clause belongs.
